changelog: - **A node of an unknown kind no longer blanks the screen, breaks Undo or stops the app from starting.** Such a node can only come from a hand-edited file. With a project open, reviewing a proposal made the whole window go blank, Apply did nothing visible, Undo or Redo onto such a state stopped half-way and left the project shown as unchanged, and a stored diagram holding one with a project open kept the app from starting at all, on every reload. Review now says which node it is and does not offer Apply, which refuses for the same reason without changing anything; Open as a document is still offered, and in this case asks first, because it replaces the open diagram for good. Undo and Redo complete and mark the project as changed, and the app starts with the diagram and its project kept, marked as changed.
